svg.text: A domain event becomes one HMAC-signed delivery per subscribed target, retried for up to 24 hours
LOOP WebhookDeliveryScheduler · every 1 s · ShedLock · virtual threads
one WebhookEvent PENDING per target · HMAC-SHA256
POST payload + X-PayFlo-Signature · 3 s / 5 s timeouts
every 10 s: rows whose next_retry_at passed with no queue entry are re-queued
